label: For "Liveness & Deepfake Selfie Detection": Confirm a live human is present and detect injected or generated faces during remote onboarding, defeating presentation and injection attacks. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Test attacks generated by the same tool used in training.
